channel.title: Srimad Bhagavad Gita
channel.description:
The Srimad Bhagavad Gita is a 700-verse Indian scripture that forms part of the Indian epic Mahabharata. It is a conversation between Prince Arjuna and Lord Krishna, just before the great war is set to begin, with Arjuna facing a moral and emotional crisis.
Torn between his duty (dharma) as a warrior and the emotional turmoil of fighting against his own people, Krishna imparts profound spiritual wisdom to Arjuna. The Gita addresses fundamental questions of life, duty, ethics, and spirituality, offering a timeless framework for living a righteous and fulfilling life.
